name: looney22
caption:
4 POINTS. BEST PLAYER ON THE FLOOR? 🎮🏀 Kevon Looney didn't need to score.

• Game 6, 2022 West semis vs Memphis, May 13, 2022
• Looney: 22 rebounds, 11 of them offensive, plus 5 assists
• We outrebound Memphis 70-44
• We win 110-96 and close out the series 4-2

Most underrated Warrior ever? 👇

beats.head: 4 POINTS?
beats.name: LOONEY
beats.vo: Kevon Looney scored four points. And he might have been the best player on the floor.

beats.head: THE BOARDS
beats.name: LOONEY
beats.vo: Twenty-two rebounds. Eleven of them on offense.

beats.head: OWNED THE GLASS
beats.name: US
beats.vo: As a team, we outrebound Memphis seventy to forty-four.

beats.head: SERIES OVER
beats.name: LOONEY
beats.vo: We win, one-ten to ninety-six. Series over. On to the conference finals.

beats.head: UNDERRATED?
beats.vo: Most underrated Warrior ever? Comment below.

facts.claim: Game 6, 2022 Western Conference semifinals vs Memphis, May 13, 2022: Warriors won 110-96 to eliminate the Grizzlies (series 4-2) and advance to the conference finals; Looney grabbed 22 rebounds; Warriors outrebounded the Grizzlies 70-44.
